name: uv (vendored local copy)
description: Installs the uv package manager from the official standalone GitHub release. Local vendored equivalent of the former ghcr.io/astral-sh/devcontainer-features/uv:1 feature (the astral-sh/devcontainer-features repo is gone and ghcr.io anonymous pulls are denied in this environment).

version.description: uv release tag to install (e.g. 0.8.15) or 'latest'
